name: Example — Living room

dimensions.notes: Illustrative numbers — this whole room is a template and will be deleted once real rooms exist.

orientation: South-west, two tall windows onto the garden

current.summary: Shows how a room page will look. Real rooms will have your photos here, a description of what's there now, what to keep and what's wrong.
issues: Hairline cracks above the window lintel
Rising damp on the lower 40 cm of the north wall
Single overhead pendant — not enough light in the evening

target.concept: A warm, low-lit sitting room built around the fireplace: lime-washed walls, the terracotta floor brought back to life, deep linen sofas and plenty of lamp light.

materials.name: Lime plaster
materials.detail: Breathable — needed because of the damp wall

materials.name: Terracotta floor
materials.detail: Strip, deep-clean, treat with linseed oil + wax

textiles.name: Curtains
textiles.detail: Heavy natural linen, floor length, on iron rods

scope: Prepare and paint walls and ceiling

surfaces.prep: Fill cracks with lime filler, treat damp section, remove loose paint

notes: Do not use acrylic/plastic paints on the damp wall — it must breathe
Protect the terracotta floor fully during works
brief.access: Room will be emptied before works start
